title: doellingeria umbellata
intro: Doellingeria umbellata, commonly known as the Gray Woodland Sunflower or Fern-leaved Sunflower, is a flowering plant species in the aster family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in the treatment of various ailments, including wounds and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Doellingeria umbellata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are known to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant, but it has been traditionally used in folk medicine to support wound healing and skin health.
